messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a dry-run of the standby allocation flow tonight to validate quotas and the new allocation PR. Can folks confirm they don't have outstanding changes that touch the allocator TF or the pool-sizing logic?

maria: i'm free to help. i already requested quota bump for apac-h100 last week, got provisional approval from vendor (ticket #V-881). i can re-check when you kick the dry-run. link: https://vendor.example.com/tickets/V-881 :thumbsup:

sam: PR #4021 touches `infra/allocator/main.tf` and `infra/allocator/scale_policy.py` — i left a last comment on the autoscaler threshold. not planning more changes.

jin: i'll own the PR review and merge window once the dry-run passes smoke tests. ping me when jobs finish.

alex: thanks. I'll kick the dry-run in ~15m. smoke tests will include: fast scale up, eviction simulation, and a short inference sweep. Quick quota check command if anyone wants to run locally: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-prod --flatten=quotas`

mike: oncall FYI — if capacity spikes during the run, please don't auto-evict dedicated pools. i'll watch billing alerts.

ops-bot: CI: infra-dryrun job queued by alex — build #1287. status: queued.

sam: leaving one nit in code but it's cosmetic. jin, feel free to merge after smoke if you approve.

ops-bot: CI: infra-dryrun build #1287 started (runner: gcp-us-west). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1287

maria: alex — vendor told me to expect a short maintenance window around 02:00 UTC, nothing blocking for our dry-run window though.

alex: noted. if smoke fails i'll post logs here. otherwise jin please merge and i'll schedule a small canary for tomorrow morning. thanks all :rocket:

ops-bot: CI: infra-dryrun build #1287 finished — result: success. artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/1287/artifacts

jin: reviewing artifacts now. quick scan looks green. merging in 5.

sam: :raised_hands:

alex: merged and canary scheduled for 06:00 UTC. I'll open a follow-up thread if anything weird shows up during canary.
